description: Defines the RenderTargetCache template class used for caching rendering targets in different graphics back-ends (D3D9, D3D11, Vulkan). It manages updates and retrieval of framebuffer attachment render targets.

classes.name: rx::RenderTargetCache
classes.description: A cache for framebuffer render targets supporting update and retrieval operations, used in graphics back-ends like D3D9, D3D11, and Vulkan.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates all render targets based on the dirty bits indicating what has changed.

methods.name: updateReadColorRenderTarget
methods.description: Updates the read color render target attachment.

methods.name: updateColorRenderTarget
methods.description: Updates a specific color attachment render target.

methods.name: getColors
methods.description: Returns the array of color render targets.

methods.name: getColorDraw
methods.description: Retrieves the color render target for drawing at a specific index.

methods.name: getColorRead
methods.description: Retrieves the color render target for reading.
